### Checklist

- [x] I searched related issues but found no solution.
- [x] The bug persists in the latest version.
- [ ] Issues without environment info and a minimal reproducible demo are hard to resolve and may receive no feedback.
- [ ] If this is not a bug report but a general question, please start a discussion at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/discussions. Otherwise, it will be closed.
- [ ] Please use English. Otherwise, it will be closed.

### Describe the bug

when i use decode radix cache and hicache，found this log: 
decode_hicache_mixin: _try_hicache_queue_load_back: 214 Hicache load_back failad for rid= 3a491sc68348b bas6d938: device_indices=0, new_indices=0, expected decode_prefix_len=64 (l1=0, l2=0, l3=64)
sglang.srt.disaggregation.decode:: pop_transferred:1630 Decode transfer failed for request rank=2 decode_req.req.rid=3a491sc68348b bas6d938  decode_req.req.bootstrap_room=xxxx


Bug reproduction: This issue occurs after I restart the decode process. Upon tracing the code, it appears that the decode component matched a prefix from the L3 cache and then sent the metadata to the prefill component. However, it failed to load the data back to the GPU, leaving the KV cache incomplete.


### Reproduction

deploy: 
prefill cp=8, enable hicache (mooncake), transfer(mooncake); decode dp=8, enable-decode-radix-cache + hicache
